task: Decorating a water bottle with vinyl stickers
query: How do I decorate a water bottle with vinyl stickers?

goal.title: Decorate a metal tumbler with three stickers
goal.description: Rinse and repeatedly wipe a rose-gold tumbler, then peel and attach three precut quotation stickers around its exterior, smoothing each with fingers and a spoon.
goal.final_state: Three stickers are pressed onto separate sides of the tumbler, which is inspected and set on the table.
procedure: Rinse the tumbler under the faucet and dry its exterior with paper towels.
Handle the clear-liquid containers and wet a fresh towel before wiping the tumbler again.
Carry the tumbler to the craft table, select the first sticker, peel its backing and press it onto the cup.
Rub the first sticker with a spoon, then position, peel and apply the second sticker.
Apply the third purple sticker, smooth it with fingers and a spoon, and rotate the finished cup for inspection.

phases.description: The tumbler is carried to the sink, rotated under running water and repeatedly wiped with paper towels.
The clear-liquid containers are opened and handled; fresh paper towel is wetted, folded and used to wipe the tumbler body and base.
The cleaned tumbler is returned to the table. A precut quotation sticker is compared with the cup, peeled, pressed onto its side and rubbed with a spoon.
The spoon is set aside while another sticker is selected and its position tested. Its backing is peeled, the sticker is pressed onto another side, and a spoon smooths it down.
The cup is rotated, the purple sticker is peeled and attached, and fingers and a spoon smooth it. The decorated cup is rotated for inspection and set down.
